Cube Clubhouse® Support

Cube Clubhouse helps anyone, of any age, learn to solve a Cube step by step. It is free, needs no account and works without an internet connection.

Contact us

Email Ira Learning LLC at iralearningllc@gmail.com. We read every message. Please tell us which device you use (iPhone or iPad) and what you were doing when the problem happened.

A note for children: please ask your parent or guardian to send the email for you, from their own email address.

Common questions

Where are my stars and times kept?

Only on your device, inside the app, and in your own iCloud or computer backup if you make one. There is no account, so they do not move between devices on their own.

How do I start again?

Open About at the bottom of the app and tap Clear Saved Progress. The app asks before it erases anything.

The steps do not match my cube.

It is almost always the way the cube is held. The middle squares never move, so check that the centres on top and in front are the colours the step names. In My Real Cube, the steps are only as right as the colours painted in, so check each side.

The spinning cube makes me uncomfortable.

Turn on Reduce Motion in Settings › Accessibility › Motion; the cube then changes without spinning. Stop and take a break if you feel unwell.

Does it need the internet?

No. It makes no network requests at all, and every part works in Aeroplane Mode.
